clue.text: Tea includes other sort of bun

indicators.note: the tea word holds the next piece within it, so it is the container here

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
else means other, as in 'someone else'

explanation.surface: Someone notices the tea has a different kind of bun inside it.
explanation.walkthrough: A CHELSEA bun is a British sticky currant bun rolled in a spiral.
explanation.definitionFit: The Chelsea is a named variety of currant bun from London.

clue.text: Black is in fashion for this painter

indicators.note: the black and is pieces sit inside the fashion word

parts.note: to cut is to fashion or shape
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
taken as written

explanation.surface: A painter says black is fashionable.
explanation.definitionFit: Picasso and Braque were artists of the movement that painted in geometric planes.

clue.text: Occurring before noble and I join king

parts.note: an earl is a nobleman
ER stands for Edwardus Rex, King Edward

explanation.surface: A nobleman and the speaker go to meet the king beforehand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and' and 'join' are links. ER usually means the Queen, but it equally abbreviates Edward Rex.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior in time, happening at a sooner point.

clue.text: Steps must be taken in case astronaut needs one

indicators.note: the steps word is to be placed inside the case word

parts.note: a suit is a legal case
paces are steps

explanation.surface: An astronaut packs steps into a carrying case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' here is a lawsuit, not luggage.
explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised outfit worn outside a craft is what every astronaut requires.

clue.text: Admit result of Education Bill takes precedence

indicators.note: the bill word goes first, ahead of the education piece

parts.note: AC (account) is a bill
learning is what schooling produces

explanation.surface: A parliamentary education bill is given priority.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Education Bill' looks like a single law; split it.
explanation.definitionFit: To concede or own up to something is to accept it as true.

clue.text: Such prescriptions need mixing, to be precise

indicators.note: the letters of the word precise must be stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions from a doctor say the medicine must be mixed exactly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'need mixing' rearranges PRECISE. 'to be' is a link; 'prescriptions' fits since an old sense of the answer is a medical prescription.
explanation.definitionFit: A cookery formula is a set of written directions, much like a doctor's prescription for a remedy.

clue.text: Disciplinary measure?

parts.note: a stick for punishment, which is also an old unit of length measuring five and a half yards

explanation.definitionFit: A cane for beating is a punishment tool, and also a historic unit of length.

clue.text: Cathy's including, a literary name for this

definitions.text: Cathy's including, a literary name for this

parts.words: Cathy's including, a literary name for this
parts.note: the girl's name with A put inside makes Cathay, the old poetic name for a great Asian country

explanation.surface: A girl's name reaches literature.
explanation.walkthrough: Put A into CATHY to get CATHAY, Marco Polo's name for the country, which is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Cathay is the medieval European name for the country of the Great Wall.

clue.text: Coat no ruddy child needed

parts.note: pale is the opposite of ruddy
a tot is a small child

explanation.surface: A coat is needed, as the child has lost the colour in its cheeks.
explanation.walkthrough: A paletot is a loose outer overcoat.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose outer jacket or overcoat, from French.

clue.text: Overhead in Mexico, it appears dull or overcast

parts.note: sombre means dull or gloomy

indicators.note: read as 'cast over', turning the word or round

explanation.surface: The Mexican sky looks gloomy or cloudy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it appears' is a link; 'overcast' turns OR into RO.
explanation.definitionFit: The wide-brimmed hat is worn on the head in Mexico.

clue.text: Jeered in military quarters

explanation.surface: Soldiers were heckled while in their own camp.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecklers who shout down a speaker are said to have done this; and soldiers lodged in barracks are housed this way.

clue.text: Faith I attached to big contract

parts.note: in bridge a slam is a contract to win all or nearly all the tricks

explanation.surface: Someone attaches themselves to a huge business deal as an act of faith.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attached to' just joins the pieces. A grand or small slam is the biggest bid in the card game bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the religion of Muslims, one of the world's great creeds.

clue.text: Second drink for a greedy person

parts.note: wine is a drink

explanation.surface: Someone who takes a second glass is called a glutton.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a pig, a gluttonous brute, is the insult meant here.

clue.text: Chips, for example, a valuable painting

explanation.surface: Wood chips are offered as an example of a precious artwork.
explanation.walkthrough: Mr Chips is the elderly schoolteacher in the novel Goodbye, Mr Chips: an aged schoolmaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Mr Chips is a veteran schoolteacher; and a canvas by a great European painter before about 1800 bears the same title.

clue.text: Finds record that's set in bowling

indicators.note: the bowling word is placed inside the other pieces

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
i.e. means 'that is', plus S for the 's
an over is a set of six balls bowled in cricket

explanation.surface: A recordbreaking spell of cricket bowling is uncovered.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an OVER is a spell of six deliveries by one bowler.
explanation.definitionFit: Things found or unearthed, as an explorer's finds.

clue.text: Sorting out bothers — role for this type

definitions.text: Sorting out bothers — role for this type

indicators.note: sorting puts things into a new order, so the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fixing problems is the job description for a particular kind of person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sorting' rearranges OUT, BOTHERS and ROLE together; the whole clue also describes the fixer who deals with problems.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixer who is called in to locate and resolve faults or disputes does exactly this.

clue.text: Suitable work on piano, or musical piece

parts.note: op. is short for opus, a work
P is piano, soft in music
a tune is a piece of music

explanation.surface: A musician chooses a fitting piano work or tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Timely and fitting, as an apt moment.

clue.text: Kind not prepared to rise in struggle for power

parts.note: class means kind or sort

indicators.note: in a down clue rising reads the word upwards, so backwards

parts.note: raw means unprepared or uncooked

explanation.surface: Unprepared people rise up in a fight for power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to rise' turns RAW to WAR; 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Marxist conflict between social strata contesting control.

clue.text: Business actors controlled initially

indicators.note: says the word for controlled goes at the front, ahead of the actors word

parts.note: limited means restricted or controlled
a company is a troupe of actors

explanation.surface: A firm's performers are kept in check from the start.
explanation.definitionFit: A firm whose owners' liability is capped is a common form of trading concern.

clue.text: Making fast low circuit

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow
a ring is a circuit

explanation.surface: A fast low circuit like a racetrack.
explanation.definitionFit: Tying a boat up is securing it to a quay.

clue.text: Coach and engine pulled up near one

parts.note: a drag is an old private coach with four horses
a gin is a machine, as in cotton gin

explanation.surface: A coach and engine stop beside someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'near' means stingy here, so 'near one' is a miser.
explanation.definitionFit: A stingy, mean person, a skinflint.

clue.text: It's not going to be the persistent sort

definitions.text: It's not going to be the persistent sort

parts.words: It's not going to be the persistent sort
parts.note: someone who is not going, who remains, is one with endurance

explanation.definitionFit: A horse or person with stamina for a long race is so called.

clue.text: Just like rain?

explanation.surface: Something is fair, or perhaps resembles rainfall.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'as right as rain' means perfectly well.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair and proper is one sense; the idiom 'as ___ as rain' gives the other.

clue.text: With this, possibly, bridge player starts

definitions.text: With this, possibly, bridge player starts

indicators.note: possibly says the word this may be rearranged into another order

explanation.surface: A bridge player starts the game using this, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges THIS to HIST after W. Bridge grew out of the older card game named here, so bridge players started with it.

clue.text: It ends in current merger, as banks come together

parts.note: sounds like financial institutions merging, but describes a stream whose flow joins a larger river where their banks meet

clue.text: Sort of square peg removed, from round hole

explanation.definitionFit: The T-square is a drafting tool; and the golfer's small peg is lifted off from every round's hole.

clue.text: Music featured in newspaper and magazine

parts.note: a rag is a slang word for a low-quality newspaper
Time is a well-known news magazine

explanation.surface: Music is reviewed in the press and a weekly journal.

clue.text: Slight flaw in lens reflected colour

reflected means the colour word is turned back to front

parts.note: red is a colour

explanation.surface: A small defect in a lens shows up as reflected colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flaw in' rearranges LENS to SLEN; 'reflected' turns RED into DER.
explanation.definitionFit: Slim and thin, as of a slight build or a slight chance.
